subject.title: fix(edit): show candidate lines with similarity scores on oldText match failure

question: Which open edit mismatch diagnostic implementation and output shape should be canonical before any branch lands?
rationale: Several open PRs close the same issue with similar but not identical candidate-line diagnostics, and automation cannot choose the permanent user-facing error format for maintainers.

options.title: Adopt This PR
options.body: Use this branch's bounded expected/found/diff/hint format, rebase it on current main, and close or rebase the other candidate PRs after merge.

options.title: Pick A Sibling Candidate
options.body: Use a sibling PR such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97269 if maintainers prefer its richer output or current-head proof.

options.title: Consolidate First
options.body: Pause landing and port the best tests, bounds, and wording into one selected branch before merging anything.

recommendation.title: Adopt This PR
recommendation.body: Use this branch's bounded expected/found/diff/hint format, rebase it on current main, and close or rebase the other candidate PRs after merge.
